_meta.source: MegaMek equipment.txt export, regenerated via build_equipment_db.py
_meta.note: Entries with verified=false are generic-padding placeholders (1 slot, crit-eligible, non-explosive, no damage type). Confirm and correct as encountered - see notes field. Pruned SMG etc.

weapon_stat_fill_pass1.note: shots_per_ton intentionally left null for all weapons (ammo-linked stat, deferred). rack_size added as new field for missile weapons. 312 weapon entries + 23 name-conflict weapons remain untouched pending a follow-up pass.

ammo_munition_consolidation_pass.note: Specialty-munition ammo variants (Thunder/Swarm/Artemis/Dead-Fire/Fragmentation/Heat-Seeking/Listen-Kill/Mine Clearance/Multi-Purpose/Narc-capable/Smoke/Anti-TSM/Acid/Inferno/Tandem-Charge/Armor-Piercing/Caseless/Flechette/Precision/Cluster/Slug/Flak/Tracer) folded into aliases of their base ammo entry - sim only needs to know 'LRM-5 ammo is loaded', not which of ~20 warhead flavors. Primitive/Extended/Enhanced/Improved/Rotary/Ultra/LB-X ammo families and ALL ATM/iATM ammo (ER/HE/IIW/IMP) were deliberately left untouched (kept distinct) per Daniel's explicit instruction - ATM ammo explosion implications need review later. A handful of CLIMPAmmoAC*/ProtoMech AC/VGL groups were also skipped due to a pre-existing tech_base mislabeling in the source data (some Caseless/Flak/Tracer/etc. rows are tagged tech_base IS despite the CL/Clan-prefixed canonical name) - flagged for Daniel, not silently fixed. This was a one-off manual edit to equipment.json, NOT mirrored in build_equipment_db.py - re-running that script will regenerate the unconsolidated form and silently undo this pass.

mech_scope_prune_pass.note: Removed ship/capital-scale and ProtoMech-only equipment out of scope for a mech-only simulator: naval weapons (18), capital missiles incl. AR10/White Shark/Killer Whale/Peacemaker/Screen (15), Mass Driver (6), torpedo weapons/ammo (63), ProtoMech-only misc equipment - PartialWing/JumpJet/UMU/Standard/Electric Discharge (5), and off-denomination (ProtoMech-scale) LRM/SRM/MRM weapons+ammo (115) - LRM kept at 5/10/15/20, SRM at 2/4/6, ATM at 3/6/9/12 (already standard), MRM at 10/20/30/40. ProtoMech AC/2, AC/4, AC/8 weapons and ammo explicitly KEPT per Daniel instruction. NOT mirrored in build_equipment_db.py - re-running that script will regenerate the unpruned form and silently undo this pass.

infantry_support_weapon_prune_pass.note: Removed MegaMek's man-portable infantry/support-weapon catalog (Rifle/Shotgun/Sniper Rifle/Laser Rifle/Laser Carbine/Pulse Laser Rifle/Blazer Rifle/Needler/Gyroslug/Gel Gun/Revolver/Paint Gun families, Portable/Semi-Portable/Support/Vintage/Bearhunter Machine Gun & Autocannon variants, Support Laser/Pulse Laser/PPC, Particle Cannon (Semi-Portable/Support), Support-scale Gauss weapons (Grand Mauler, Tsunami Heavy, Thunderstroke/II, Gungnir Heavy Support - ammo-only, orphaned), Plasma Rifle (Man-Portable), Flamer (Man-Portable), Grenade Launcher (Compact), and Prosthetic weapons - none of these are mech-mountable. Also removed Tele-operated Missile (Kraken T) + Kraken/KrakenT ammo, a capital missile missed by the earlier naval/capital prune pass. ISMagshotGR (Magshot Gauss Rifle) and its ammo were explicitly KEPT per Daniel's instruction and both marked explosive=true (explosion_damage left null pending confirmation - not invented). 'Rifle (Cannon' was explicitly KEPT - it's a data-merge artifact of the legitimate mech-mountable IS Light/Medium/Heavy Rifle Cannon family (see build_equipment_db.py merge bug, flagged separately, not fixed here). NOT mirrored in build_equipment_db.py.

mfuk_removal_and_os_ios_fold_pass.note: MFUK Plasma Rifle (mfukplasmarifle) removed entirely per Daniel: not canon. This was the only Clan Plasma Rifle entry in the DB - CLPlasmaRifle/ClanPlasmaRifle have no replacement entry now; Clan Plasma Cannon (clplasmacannon) is unaffected and distinct. OS/I-OS/IOS one-shot launcher pass: per Daniel, OS entries remain separate from their base full-size weapon and from ammo (distinct mechanic - single shot, no reload), but IOS/I-OS (Improved One-Shot) folded into their paired OS entry as pure aliases since OS vs IOS is not functionally distinguished in this sim. 40 IOS/I-OS entries folded into 40 paired OS entries. 7 OS-only entries with no IOS/I-OS counterpart in the source data were left untouched: CLSRMT1OS, CLSRT3OS, CLSRT5OS, ISImprovedNarc(OS), CLAdvancedSRM2/4/6OS. NOT mirrored in build_equipment_db.py - re-running that script will regenerate the unpruned/unfolded form.

thb_legattack_cruisemissile_gac_bomb_ac1.note: THB (Tactical Handbook) equipment removed (17 entries). LegAttack/SwarmMek/SwarmWeaponMek/StopSwarm pseudo-weapon action markers removed (4). CruiseMissiles + ammo removed (8). GAC/2,4,6,8 + ammo removed (8). External aerospace ordinance bombs removed (11): BombTAG, BombRL, HEBomb, ClusterBomb, LGBomb, TAGBomb, InfernoBomb, ThunderBomb, FABomb Small/Large Ammo, RL10 Ammo(Bomb). Note: Thunder-Vibrabomb ammo variants on LRM/ArrowIV entries were NOT touched - those are legitimate mine-laying warheads for mech/vehicle-mountable launchers, not external ordinance, despite the name. AC/15 weapon+ammo removed (2). AAA Missile and adjacent aerospace-only external-ordinance missiles removed (11): AAAMissile+ammo, ASMissile+ammo, ASEWMissile+ammo, AlamoMissile+ammo, LAAMissile+ammo, and an orphaned Wire-Guided Missile Launcher Ammo with no parent weapon. Anti-Missile Systems (ISAMS/CLAMS/Laser AMS) were explicitly KEPT - those are mech-mountable missile defense, not offensive ordinance. Arrow IV (ArrowIV/ISArrowIV/CLArrowIV incl. all flavor ammo) was explicitly KEPT - real mech/vehicle-mountable artillery, distinct from the aerospace-only missiles removed here. Primitive/Prototype equipment (183 entries) folded as aliases into their base mech-scale equivalent - sim treats primitive/prototype gear as mechanically identical to the modern version. 3 entries (IS Primitive/IS Primitive Fighter/IS Primitive Aerospace) had no mech-scale equivalent (aerospace unit-type tags, not equipment) and were removed outright rather than force-folded. LRT (LRM Torpedo) folded as aliases into matching LRM entries, including the OS variant (8 entries; I-OS variants were already folded into OS in the prior pass). NOT mirrored in build_equipment_db.py.

rulebook_table_fill_pass.source: Daniel's Weapon_Rules_Tables rip: Total Warfare pp. 303-306, Tactical Operations: AUE pp. 216-230, Interstellar Operations pp. 217-226
rulebook_table_fill_pass.note: Filled only fields that were null (210 fields across 104 weapon entries); never overwrote an existing value except the Extended LRM range correction. Matching validated first against already-filled entries: 368/372 values agreed, the 4 disagreements were the Extended LRM ranges (corrected). Skipped: special-rules weapons (ATM/iATM, HAG, MML, VSP, Heavy Gauss, Snub-Nose PPC, artillery, Narc, mortars, plasma, TSEMP, AMS, pods, MG arrays, Silver Bullet Gauss), damage cells carrying footnotes (flamers, Nail/Rivet Gun), one-shot (OS/IOS) launchers (no table rows; need a ruling), and items with no table row. Each filled entry's notes field names the table row used. verified flags unchanged. shots_per_ton and minimum range not filled.
rulebook_table_fill_pass.min_range: range.min added to 161 weapons whose short/medium/long match their rulebook row exactly (7 from a dash cell, read as 0 = no minimum). Weapons without a matching row have no range.min - treat as unknown, not 0. A second pass matched 7 more by word order, accepting a row only if its short/medium/long equal the entry's.

one_shot_fill.note: One-shot (OS/I-OS) launchers given their base launcher's damage_type/damage/heat/range/rack_size where theirs were null (Daniel: same range and damage stats as the primary). The fire-once limit is not enforced - INTEGRATION__stubs.stub_one_shot warns each time one fires.

coolant_pod_fix.note: coolantpod: category ammo -> misc, explosion_damage 2 (Core p.208). Not mirrored in build_equipment_db.py.

shots_per_ton_fill.source: Core Rulebook Weapons and Equipment Tables pp.248-254 (Inner Sphere / Clan weapons)
shots_per_ton_fill.note: shots_per_ton filled on weapon entries (null only) by name + tech-base match; 'OS' = one-shot. Bins are 1 ton, so a bin holds this many shots. Not mirrored in build_equipment_db.py.

core_table_fill.note: Null damage_type / damage_per_shot / heat / range / rack_size filled from the Core weapon tables (type code M -> Missile, DE/P -> Energy, DB -> Ballistic). Existing values never overwritten. Not mirrored in build_equipment_db.py.
